# Plugins

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate_bundles_doc.py from registry/ — do not edit by hand. -->

Each **subject** (a tool, library, language, or workflow) is one Claude Code
plugin. Skills are invoked as `/<subject>:<facet>`; agents are delegated as
subagents (auto-routed by their description).

## At a glance

| Plugin | Description |
|---|---|
| [`go`](#go) | Go — idiomatic naming and secure error handling |
| [`rust`](#rust) | Rust — read and navigate unfamiliar Rust, explain constructs, sanity-check correctness |

| [`kubernetes`](#kubernetes) | Kubernetes — SRE-grade rollouts, HA design, and incident response |

## Install

Add the marketplace, then install the subject plugin(s) you need:

```bash
/plugin marketplace add nq-rdl/agent-extensions
/plugin install <subject>@rdl-agent-extensions
```

New to the team? Install `rdl-team` first for onboarding, setup, and config-management workflows:

```bash
/plugin install rdl-team@rdl-agent-extensions
```
